names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 2 aprilie, «Sfântul Cuvios Tit, făcătorul de minuni».
Read out of saint.gr's line for 2 Απριλίου, «Όσιος Τίτος ο Θαυματουργός», with the rank word and the epithet left off.

Read out of the Ohrid Prologue's first heading for the Julian 2 April on pravoslavno.rs, „Преп. Тит Чудотворац“, with the rank word Преп. left off and with Чудотворац left off as well — it is a rank word in this source's usage and this folder already carries `wonderworker` in `types`. The heading gives no epithet beyond those, so the bare forename is what the source gives.

Read out of the title on the name link behind his line for 2 апреля ст. ст., name page 2111, «Тит Чудотворец, иеромонах», with the grade word «иеромонах» left off. The day’s own line declines both words, «Тита чудотворца». The epithet is kept because the forename alone would not tell him apart: `titus-the-apostle` already holds the bare «Тит» as its ru form, and this folder holds it as its sr form.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 2 апреля ст. ст. — «Прп. Тита чудотворца (IX).»
Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 2 aprilie — «Sfântul Cuvios Tit, făcătorul de minuni»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 2ας Απριλίου — «Όσιος Τίτος ο Θαυματουργός»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 2 Απριλίου εκάστου έτους» — a fixed feast on 2 April every year, the same day as the listing. The page gives him no year, no country and no monastery, and says nothing of the iconoclast trouble doxologia.ro's life turns on. It prints a couplet, two apolytikia, a kontakion and two kathismata.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 15.04.2026 (2. април ст. ст.) — „Преп. Тит Чудотворац“

attestations.note: The day's first entry, on the same menologion day the Romanian and the Greek already keep in this folder, and the same portrait: Christ loved from his youth, the world left for a monastery, the angelic habit, the narrow way, humility and obedience in which he surpassed „не само братију него и све људе“ — the phrase the Romanian life has as surpassing not only the brothers of his house but all men — purity of body and soul kept from his young years, and an unshakeable pillar of the Church of God in the time of the iconoclast heresy. **A date was added where this folder had none**: „Упокоји се мирно у IX веку“, he reposed peacefully in the ninth century, and the folder's own life says in its own words that doxologia gives no year and no century and that saint.gr gives none either. So this is the first and only placing of him in time, and it agrees with the iconoclast trouble both other pages name. Two smaller things are new: that the gift of wonderworking was given him for his humility and purity **both in life and after death**, where the other two pages give it to him living; and that he left many disciples behind him. The Prologue prints no troparion and no kontakion; the hymn in this folder is the Romanian's. The stored form Тит folds with nothing: no other folder in the corpus holds a Serbian form of this spelling.

hymns.text: Cu curgerile lacrimilor tale ai lucrat pustiul cel neroditor şi cu suspinurile cele dintru adânc ai făcut ostenelile tale însutit roditoare; şi te-ai făcut luminător lumii, strălucind cu minunile, Tit, părintele nostru. Roagă-te lui Hristos Dumnezeu ca să mântuiască sufletele noastre.

source.text: Doxologia — Troparul Sfântului Cuvios Tit, făcătorul de minuni, Glasul 8

english.text: With the streams of thy tears thou didst till the barren desert, and with sighs from the depths thou didst make thy labours bear fruit a hundredfold; and thou becamest a light to the world, shining with miracles, O Titus our father. Pray to Christ God that our souls may be saved.

hymns.text: Ἐν σοί Πάτερ ἀκριβῶς διεσώθη τό κατ᾽ εἰκόνα· λαβών γάρ τόν σταυρόν, ἠκολούθησας τῷ Χριστῷ, καί πράττων ἐδίδασκες, ὑπερορᾷν μέν σαρκός, παρέρχεται γάρ· ἐπιμελεῖσθαι δέ ψυχῆς, πράγματος ἀθανάτoυ· διό καί μετά Ἀγγέλων συναγάλλεται, Ὅσιε Τίτε τό πνεῦμά σου.

source.text: saint.gr — Ἀπολυτίκιον, Ἦχος πλ. δ’, on the page of Όσιος Τίτος ο Θαυματουργός. This is the common apolytikion of a venerable father, with only his name set into its last clause; the page prints it first under his name, so it is copied whole as the page has it.

english.text: In thee, O Father, that which was made according to the image was kept safe; for taking up the cross thou didst follow Christ, and by thy doing thou didst teach us to overlook the flesh, since it passes away, and to care for the soul, a thing immortal. Therefore, O venerable Titus, thy spirit rejoices together with the angels.

hymns.text: Ἀνατεθεῖς ἀπὸ παιδὸς τῷ Κυρίῳ, ἀγγελικῶς ἐπολιτεύσω ἐν κόσμῳ, καὶ τῶν θαυμάτων εἴληφας τὴν χάριν ἐκ Θεοῦ, ὅθεν ἐχρημάτισας, Μοναζόντων ἀλείπτης, Τίτε παμμακάριστε, καὶ σοφὸς οἰκονόμος. Ἄλλα μὴ παύση Πάτερ ἐκτενῶς, ὑπὲρ τοῦ κόσμου, Θεὸν ἰλεούμενος.

source.text: saint.gr — Έτερον Ἀπολυτίκιον (Κατέβασμα), Ἦχος δ’, Ὁ ὑψωθεῖς ἐν τῷ Σταυρῷ, on the page of Όσιος Τίτος ο Θαυματουργός. It is his own, and names him: Τίτε παμμακάριστε.

english.text: Dedicated to the Lord from childhood, thou didst live in the world as an angel lives, and thou didst take from God the grace of wonders; whence thou wast made a trainer of monastics, O all-blessed Titus, and a wise steward. But cease not, O Father, to entreat God earnestly for the world.

hymns.text: Ἐγκρατείας ἄνθραξι, σαυτόν καθάρας, ἀρετῶν ἐξήστραψας, φωτοειδεῖς μαρμαρυγάς, καταφαιδρύνων τούς ψάλλοντας· Χαίροις ὦ Τίτε, Πατέρων ἀγλάϊσμα.

source.text: saint.gr — Κοντάκιον, Ἦχος δ’, Ἐπεφάνης σήμερον, on the page of Όσιος Τίτος ο Θαυματουργός.

english.text: Having cleansed thyself with the coals of abstinence, thou didst flash out the light-shaped rays of the virtues, gladdening those who sing: Rejoice, O Titus, adornment of the Fathers.

hymns.text: Жития молву оставил еси/ и тихо, все житие твое пожив, мудре, к Богу прешел еси,/ чудоносне отче наш, Тите преподобне.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 2 апреля ст. ст. — «Кондак преподобного Тита чудотворца», глас 4. His own, and it names him.

english.text: You left the noise of this life behind, and having lived the whole of your life in quietness, O wise one, you passed over to God, our wonder-bearing father Titus the venerable.

death.note: The Ohrid Prologue at pravoslavno.rs for the Julian 2 April: „Упокоји се мирно у IX веку“ — he reposed peacefully in the ninth century. It is the only source read for this folder that places him in time at all: this folder's life records that doxologia.ro gives no year and no century and that saint.gr gives none either, and that the iconoclast trouble both of them name was the only thing that placed him. The century does not conflict with that trouble. `node .tmp/dd.mjs "9th century"` reads in Russian and Greek.
